decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set focuses on well-rated speakers across different price points and use cases, excluding non-speaker items like chargers and cases. The Sony SRS-XB43 was chosen as the final purchase because it offers the best combination of brand reliability, high performance (24-hour battery, EXTRA BASS), and an excellent 4.7 rating with over 5,000 reviews. While the Harman Kardon and Sonos options are also high-quality, the Sony's IP67 waterproof rating makes it more versatile for both indoor and outdoor use compared to the Onyx Studio 6 or the Wi-Fi-only Sonos set.
